question: Qual o ticket médio dos pedidos?
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(order_total) FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(price + freight_value) AS order_total FROM raw.order_items GROUP BY order_id) t

question: Qual a receita total da plataforma?
Qual o tempo médio de entrega dos pedidos, em dias?
expected_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM AVG(order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400.0 FROM raw.orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

question: Qual o percentual de pedidos entregues com atraso?
expected_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM raw.orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

question: Qual a nota média das avaliações dos clientes?
Quantos tickets de suporte existem por status?
expected_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM raw.support_tickets GROUP BY status
